description: Use this when you need to insert a new feature line into a script. Insert a new feature line into a kernelCAD script before the last top-level return statement. Returns the modified code as text plus diagnostics from re-evaluating the result. Direct editing is authored here too: use `body.deleteFace(faces)` to heal a removed-face opening, or `body.replaceFace(faces, { origin, normal })` for a parallel planar replacement; the runtime refuses any result that does not pass its single-solid BRepCheck gate. Primitives that accept faceLabels (box, cylinder, extrudeRect, extrudeCircle, extrudePolygon, extrudeRoundedRect) can receive `opts.faceLabels` in the inserted code — use `lookup_api` to see `featureKindFaceLabels` for the full value schema.

feature_code.description: Single-statement source line to insert. A full-turn G4 revolve has a narrow analytic certificate only for a terminal, untransformed revolve with no downstream feature consumers or face labels, using an exact unsegmented two-semicircle circle whose captured binary64 points prove exact dyadic symmetry, an exactly representable minor radius, and R > r > 0. The lowerer constructs one OCCT analytic torus face, independently enumerates both closed periodic self-seams, measures both stored p-curve branches at finite D0–D4 stations within edge-tolerance limits, and requires a valid nonempty one-solid result with finite positive volume. An outward-rounded torus period bound covers the full seam domains; station readings are conformance checks, not the proof. Face-labeled, transformed, downstream-consumed, segmented, near-circular, axis-touching/crossing, partial-turn, incomplete, and otherwise unsupported cases remain sampled or uncertified; nine stations alone do not prove continuity.
